description: This file is a code-behind for the ASP.NET Web Forms page 'EditMCQ.aspx'. It handles UI interactions such as navigation, course selection, and session management within an online examination system. The code includes event handlers for button clicks and dropdown list changes, primarily for filtering and selecting courses based on semester. No external modules are imported beyond standard ASP.NET namespaces, and no additional public symbols are exposed.
